headline: DPWH Relieves Las Piñas–Muntinlupa Maintenance Chief Over Reported Delayed Calamity Response
seoTitle: DPWH Maintenance Chief Relieved Over Calamity Response | FMB News
seoDescription: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon relieved the Las Piñas–Muntinlupa maintenance chief, citing unsatisfactory performance and delayed calamity response.
deck: The August 29 memorandum ordered an immediate turnover of pending documents, records and office property.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon relieved engineer Loreto Balena Jr. as maintenance chief of the Las Piñas–Muntinlupa District Engineering Office.

The August 29 memorandum cited unsatisfactory performance, lack of urgency and delayed response to calamities. Balena was directed to turn over pending documents, official records and office property.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The order came as Metro Manila and nearby areas dealt with heavy monsoon rains and flooding. Reports did not establish that any single flood incident was caused by Balena's actions or inaction.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Maintenance offices are responsible for keeping public infrastructure and flood-response systems operational. The case puts attention on accountability standards during emergencies.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for the appointment or designation of a replacement, any formal administrative proceedings and whether DPWH releases performance findings beyond the relief memorandum.
